title: A joint resolution approving the location of a memorial to commemorate and honor the members of the Armed Forces who served on active duty in support of Operation Desert Storm or Operation Desert Shield.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This joint resolution approves the location within Washington, DC and the surrounding area of the National Desert Storm and Desert Shield Memorial authorized to be established under the Carl Levin and Howard P. `Buck' McKeon National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2015.

summary.headline: Congress approved the location in the Washington, DC area for a national memorial honoring troops who served in Operation Desert Storm and Operation Desert Shield.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution approves where the National Desert Storm and Desert Shield Memorial will be built in Washington, DC and the surrounding area. The memorial itself was already authorized by an earlier defense law passed in 2014. This resolution only settles the site, which the law requires Congress to approve.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The resolution took effect when it was enacted on March 31, 2017.
